sources.title: feel-it · PyPI
sources.snippet: FEEL-IT: Emotion and Sentiment Classification for the Italian Language Abstract Sentiment analysis is a common task to understand people's reactions online. Still, we often need more nuanced information: is the post negative because the user is angry or because they are sad? An abundance of approaches has been introduced for tackling both tasks.
